mechanisms: Per-bucket quote==default memcmp is rustc MIR JumpThreading: a separate `let amount = if creator {take} else {take}` puts the take switch within MIR JT's 5-block backtrack of `creator && native`, duplicating zero-check+memcmp per bucket.

SBF analyzeBranch cannot analyze conditional branches, so MachineBlockPlacement glues each conditional block to its next IR block: layout follows rustc's LLVM block creation order (first reference in MIR RPO; RPO visits the first switch successor first).
`match creator as u8 {1 => vault, _ => validate}` makes the creator path codegen first; `if creator`/`if !creator` both lower to [0: protocol, ..].

Protocol-native threading through the recipient clone is MIR JT: an explicit `(false,true) => {}` arm in `match (creator,native)` gives that edge its own MIR block (MIR JT never threads through a SwitchInt predecessor of a multi-predecessor block).

LLVM cold call sites: a call whose pre-inline block frequency is < 2% of entry gets inline threshold 45; after the threading the shared rent/token join's clone is at 1.5-1.7% unless the admit errors are merged (Result helper), raising it above 2%.
